title: VANTA release manifest
description: Describes one release of the VANTA Client (Fabric mod jar) or the VANTA Launcher. Stored in shared/releases/<product>-<version>.json. The downloadUrl, size and sha256 of every file are filled in by the release workflow from the real uploaded artifacts; an empty downloadUrl means 'not published yet'.

version.description: Semantic version of the product (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release suffix).

minecraftVersion.description: Minecraft Java Edition version the release targets.

fabricVersion.description: Fabric Loader version the release is built against / installs.

files.description: Downloadable files of the release. The first entry is the primary artifact.

changelog.description: Repository-relative path of the release notes markdown (website/content/changelog/<product>-<version>.md).

notes.description: Optional free-text note shown next to the release (e.g. known issues).

minecraftVersion.description: The client is built for exactly one Minecraft version.

name.description: File name as uploaded to the GitHub Release (no path separators).

downloadUrl.description: Absolute https URL, or an empty string while the file is not published.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest, or an empty string while unpublished.
